silhouette.reason: ISO 20 ft box with corner castings, armoured side bays, door end with four cam lock bars and status strip: reads as a container at once. The long side is a flat plane at grazing angles. The top line stays straight on purpose (stacking/twist-lock contract).
fixes: deeper bay relief (8–10 cm) or a trapezoidal rib between bays so the long-side outline is not a flat plane

proportions.reason: Frame 6.058 × 2.438 × 2.591 m on ISO 668; castings and their centres pass the measures; doors fill the opening between the posts.
fixes: check the door-leaf hinge spacing against an ISO door photo (four hinges per leaf)

materials.reason: Painted steel shell and off-white frame, cast corner castings, galvanised lock bars, glow strip and keypad. But the weathering shows as large triangle-shaped grey/brown blotches on the roof and side bays in sheet.png (the vertex colour follows the triangulation), and in hero.png as soft smears rather than rust and bleaching.
fixes: weather on a finer, regular vertex grid on the side and roof plates (or as a texture lane) so the colour stops following triangle shapes
roughness variation where hands touch (door handles, keypad)

detail.reason: Bays with seams, vents, bolts, stencilled owner code, hazard bands, cam keepers and handles, hinge knuckles, forklift pockets. No gasket line or customs seal; roof is ribs over a plate.
fixes: door gasket line and customs seal on the right leaf
forklift pockets as real recesses with a lip

wear.reason: Chipped edges, rust streaks from the bolts, dents, bleached roof and dirt at the sill tell a working life, but the triangle-shaped blotches undercut it and the doors are not weathered.
fixes: run the door leaves through weather() too (hinge space, separate call)

lod.reason: LOD2 (736) keeps the orange band, lock bars, status strip and bay grid; the roof turns a lighter flat value split by one big diagonal shading seam.
fixes: keep the roof ribs as quads at LOD2 so the roof value matches
split the LOD2 roof into a regular quad grid so the diagonal seam disappears

technical.reason: QA PASS incl. the weather gate; 22 914 / 8 342 / 736, one material, glow + light socket, doorArc check. LOD0 is heavy for a prop because weather() refinement splits every long bevel.
fixes: weather only the side/roof plates (not the bevelled frame) to halve the refinement cost
